meta.date_format: Every date comes from a datetime and is formatted by one helper: 'Mon, Oct 26, 9:12 AM'. Never hand-write a weekday.

steps.heading: Missed call
steps.blurb: A call goes unanswered. Within a minute the caller gets this text.

steps.heading: Questions
steps.blurb: Asked one at a time, in this order. The assistant moves on only once it has an answer.

steps.heading: Booking
steps.blurb: Once it has the answers, the assistant checks your calendar and books a free time.

steps.heading: No reply
steps.blurb: If the customer goes quiet, the assistant sends two reminders. Then the texting stops.

steps.heading: When the assistant steps back
steps.blurb: When a text needs a person, the assistant stops scheduling and passes the customer's details on.

steps.heading: START, HELP and STOP
steps.blurb: Required by phone companies. Most businesses never change these.
